Variants.Content: Entry The Crown Territory is a royal territory formed directly around King's Landing, Blackwater Bay, Dragonstone and the offshore peninsula, rather than an ancient kingdom with unified local traditions. It draws its power from its capital, its ports, its royal castles, its taxes, and its nobles located close to the Iron Throne; Royal lords are more likely to see the rewards and threats of royal power than remote vassals, but they are also more likely to be affected by court changes.
